say:1:1611267001:1.text: You seem curious about the Grand Mentor's methods.
say:1:1611267001:1.source_cn: 咦，这位同学，你似乎对大导师的治疗方法很好奇？

say:2:1611267002:1.text: Yeah. I've seen regular healers and magic healers, but never "psychological healing".
say:2:1611267002:1.source_cn: 是啊，我见过普通医师治病，也见过魔法医疗手段，但还从来...

say:3:1611267003:2.text: And man, it's kind of hilarious! The weird sounds the students make, the aides all decked out... it's like watching a bad campus play.
say:3:1611267003:2.source_cn: 而且你看，这场面太有趣了，简直像演戏一样。无论是那些得...

say:4:1611267004:1.text: School's boring anyway. Might as well enjoy the show.
say:4:1611267004:1.source_cn: 反正上学这么无聊，我就当是看戏咯，还不用花钱呢。

choice_prompt:5:1611267004.text: School's boring anyway. Might as well enjoy the show.
choice_prompt:5:1611267004.source_cn: 反正上学这么无聊，我就当是看戏咯，还不用花钱呢。

say:6:1611267005:1.text: Who knows... but he sure sounds impressive.
say:6:1611267005:1.source_cn: 谁知道呢……听上去这个大导师还挺厉害的。

say:7:1611267007:1.text: I'm all for the Lyceum thriving, but I stay on the sidelines, just cheering.
say:7:1611267007:1.source_cn: 我对莱希拉姆的发展充满信心，并保持中立、乐观、积极的旁...

say:8:1611267008:1.text: This is serious. You aren't concerned at all?
say:8:1611267008:1.source_cn: 这可是件大事，你怎么毫不在意？

say:9:1611267009:1.text: Look, I'm not top of the class, but I'm not failing either. I mind my own business. Yeah, I bend a few harmless rules, but I don't make real trouble.
say:9:1611267009:1.source_cn: 你瞧，我在莱希拉姆算不上优秀学生，但也没差到不合格的程...

say:10:1611267010:1.text: So yeah, I stay neutral when it comes to things like this.
say:10:1611267010:1.source_cn: 所以，这就是我的位置——在围观席上为各位鼓掌。

choice:5:0:1.text: You think he can really cure them?
choice:5:0:1.source_cn: 你觉得大导师能治好失语症吗？
choice:5:0:1.male: You think he can really cure them?
choice:5:0:1.female: You think he can really cure them?
